text:
Hannah Brooks: Hey team — Callisto Metrics sent renewal INV-CM-2026 and AP flagged it. Invoice lists 10k included calls/month but our telemetry shows ~900k/mo. Can someone help reconcile?

Diego Ramos: Yikes. Upload the PDF? I’ll pull usage.

Hannah Brooks: PDF: https://files.redwood/procurement/callisto_renewal_may.pdf — line items: Starter $18k/yr (10k/mo), onboarding $2k, overage $0.01/call.

Diego Ramos: Our last three months: 2026-02 820k, 2026-03 910k, 2026-04 880k -> ~10.2M/yr. Starter is obviously wrong.

Mira (Callisto Sales): Hi Hannah — sorry for the mix-up, the renewals system defaulted to Starter. Options I can offer: (A) Committed 10M/yr @ $0.003/call + $3k seats = $33k/yr, onboarding waived; (B) Committed 12M/yr @ $0.0026/call + $4k seats = $35,200/yr. Both include monthly invoice math and a 45-day pilot period.

Hannah Brooks: Procurement ask: 1) Written 12-month price lock, 2) Explicit monthly USD overage cap (prefer $4k/mo) rather than %s, 3) Pilot termination rights (60 days), 4) Net30 payment, 5) DPA + SOC2, 6) corrected invoice for AP showing line-item math.

Diego Ramos: Quick usage snippet to paste to vendor:
```
month,api_calls
2026-02,820000
2026-03,910000
2026-04,880000
```

Mira (Callisto Sales): I can commit to a 12-month price lock and will add a $4k/mo first-year overage cap. Will include DPA/SOC2 and update invoice to show: "Committed Consumption - 10,000,000 calls @ $0.003 = $30,000 + seats $3,000 = $33,000". Pilot 60 days ok.

LegalBot: Reminder: include data deletion and subprocessor disclosure in the DPA. Also request indemnity language and export control clause if vendor processes PII.

FinanceOps: FYI commits > $25k/yr need FinanceOps approval and a PO. Route once redline and invoice are final: https://intra.redwood/finance/commit-policy

Hannah Brooks: Great — Mira, please post the redline and corrected invoice here and I’ll route to Legal/FinanceOps. Thanks! :thumbsup:
